description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class which manages network discovery of gateways via Bonjour/mDNS. It includes data structures for discovered gateways and debug logs, and methods to start/stop discovery, handle results, and maintain internal state.

classes.name: DebugLogEntry
classes.description: Represents a log entry with timestamp and message for debugging purposes.

classes.name: DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Represents a network-discovered gateway with various attributes like name, endpoint, IDs, and connection info.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs if disabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the network discovery process by creating browsers for specified domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops discovery and cleans up resources.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of gateways based on current discoveries, tracking added and removed gateways.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on the current browser states.
